title: Highlight of my vacation!
text:
My time on this tour left me with memories for a lifetime... To start off, my guide Alexis was incredibly knowledgeable and personable. He answered every question I had with enthusiasm -- I could tell that he really enjoyed his job and loved sharing his city with me. 

Riding through the city on a carriage was a beautiful way to see the city center. Going to the Feria was such a privilege, and left me with the best memories! title: To enjoy it - you have to be part of it
text:
Sevilla Feria is (mostly) a very big, private party event - which, if you are reading this review you probably already know. Unless you have an invite to one of the wonderful party Cassetas you could just wander around looking at a lot of Spanish people having a party to which you are not invited !!
This tour may seem expensive but to join in the true Feria experience of parading in a horse carriage and then - most importantly - getting access to a real Casseta experience is worthwhile.

title: It's worth it
text: My fiance and I booked the private Sevilla tour for the first day of the April Fair. The fair itself can be elusive for nonlocals because of the private party aspect of the casettas and we were worried that we'd leave Sevilla not understanding the culture and significance of the fair. We didn't realize when we were booking the tour that it involved a horse and buggy ride and were nervous that we would be overdoing it. Not at all.
